notes.title: You can select to play the "monetized" version in Main Menu settings.
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590786/4752c41b9914e2ebdd398749bd2292dea9d6b861.png

If you need to comply with some rules or just play a "clean" version, this is the thing for you!
It doesn't just replace words with *******, but does it in a much more tasteful way. Won't spoil how, just give it a try.

Censored is only available for English so far. Hoping to include other languages in later updates.

notes.title: EP Release Feb 12th (Don’t Break My Tools)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590786/71fafb399e9677e2338448f87217de4d927f76bf.pngDon't Break My Tools EP features 4 instrumental tracks of different styles, is scheduled to come out on February 12th 2021 and will be available on pretty much all music platforms.

Check the BTG blog for more details.

notes.title: Update: Way Nicer Save System!
notes.notes:
Just published a big update for the demo that makes it easier and more fun to replay the game. 
- Multiple saves/loads.
- See the entire map of different choices you have.
- Directly revisit previous scenes to try other story branches.

notes.title: First update for the demo. A bit more content in the form of Easter eggs.
notes.notes:
By popular demand, I added about 20-25 easter eggs to the part of the game where you're asked if you're an idiot over and over again.

My Discord server has a competition related to it. Winner gets a $25 Steam gift card.
Y'all are more than welcome to join and compete at https://discord.gg/CUXjBJw
